shellCommands.command: git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100; cat package.json

for f in lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "unstable_instant\|prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -40

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; ls 04-functions | grep -i -E "prefetch|navigation"; cat 04-functions/prefetch.md; grep -n "prefetch\b\|navigation" ../../../../dist/server/request/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "prefetch\|navigation" ../../../../cache.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
